jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React) based in Romania.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will build and evolve scalable, secure, and high-performing applications across both backend and frontend layers. You will work extensively with .NET and C# alongside React, Redux, and JavaScript to deliver impactful software solutions. The role combines hands-on engineering with opportunities to influence architecture, technical decisions, and development practices. You will contribute to cloud-based solutions using Google Cloud Platform and modern CI/CD practices. Working closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions. You will also support code quality and team development through mentoring, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, secure, reliable, and efficient full-stack applications.
Build and maintain backend services using .NET, C#, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
Develop responsive and maintainable frontend components using React, Redux, and JavaScript.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define and deliver new features.
Ensure applications meet high standards for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code while following established engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive technical feedback, and promote high standards of code quality.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to identify and resolve performance or reliability issues.
Contribute to software architecture discussions, technical design decisions, and long-term engineering strategy.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and deployment.
Apply cloud technologies and DevOps practices to improve development and delivery workflows.
Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
Keep up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends and identify opportunities for technical improvement.

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in .NET and C#.
Solid hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
Strong frontend development skills with React, Redux, and JavaScript.
Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and cloud-based application development.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, and scalable application design.
Experience using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and software development workflows.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, and continuously evolving environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A proactive mindset with a willingness to mentor colleagues and contribute to continuous technical improvement.

Benefits

Fully remote working model, with the opportunity to work from Latam, Europe.
Flexible working conditions designed to support a healthy work-life balance.
Opportunity to work on challenging and impactful technology projects.
Exposure to modern cloud technologies, full-stack development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Hands-on experience with technologies including .NET, React, GCP, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and modern engineering tooling.
Collaboration with an international, diverse, and cross-cultural team of technology professionals.
Opportunities to contribute to architectural decisions and influence technical direction.
Full-time employment with the flexibility and autonomy of a remote-first environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, subject to the employment arrangement and location.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
About us

𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐓𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬, founded in 2020, is a recruitment company specialized in IT Recruitment,
𝐈𝐓 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠, but also covering Finance & Accounting, Marketing, HR, and Customer Support
roles. We connect clients with top talent across all seniority levels, from juniors to managers, in technologies like Java, Python, .NET, SAP, AI and more. With a d edicated team, flat & success-fee model, transparent pricing, and long-term affordable partnerships ( with relevant volume discounts)
, we are committed to delivering guaranteed hires and sustainable recruitment solutions.

Essentials 

Job title:
Software Engineer – Paid internship
Location:
Romania, in-person Bucharest Blvd Unirii
Type:
six-month paid employment contract, Subject to satisfactory performance and mutual agreement, the contract may be extended or prolonged following the completion of the initial six-month period.

Offer

Competitive salary and trust-based working hours.
Equity packages
Gym /sport subscription
Private health subscription
Free lunch in the office

Client

Our client is a global wearable technology company based in Vancouver, Washington, dedicated to empowering over 2 billion frontline workers worldwide. Their mission is to help them work safely, efficiently, and with confidence. Trusted by industry leaders, is recognized as the gold standard in industrial smart glasses.

Role

Our client is looking to expand his capabilities by recruiting someone to support the Software Team’s efforts in documenting their products from a functional and technical PoV as well as support internal and external efforts to communicate said documentation. Internally, their Customer Success, Customer Support and Channel departments frequently require help from a fully technical person and externally, ISVs who develop apps for their platform require in-depth technical support to integrate with their softwrae as well.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities

Draft and review technical documentation:
How-to’s for end users
Security overviews of certain products
How-to’s for external developer ecosystem
Release notes
Communicate with Software, Customer Success and Customer Support cleanly and accurately
Support with release management end-to-end
Shadow a Senior SWE with experience in the above-mentioned tasks

Your Key Competencies

What We’re Looking For (Required)
Great attention to detail and highly organized
Entry-level knowledge of diverse software systems (familiarity with terms like API, REST, AOSP, IOT, STT, TTS)
Some experience with AI and orchestration (writing skills, using agents)
Good speaking and writing skills

Tech stack

Legacy Cloud: .NET + Angular
New Cloud: Python + Node + React
On-Device: small amount of Java + mainly Kotlin

Note

Working Schedule:
Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
.
Open to final-year students and recent graduates

Employment eligibility to work in Romania is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

jobs.title: .NET / C# Web Application Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lohn - CHF115'000 - 135'000

Digitale Lösungen für Sozialversicherungen entwickeln – klingt das nach Deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Unser Rocken Partner zählt zu den führenden Anbietern von Softwarelösungen für Ausgleichskassen und Pensionskassen. Mit etablierten Produkten und innovativen SaaS-Angeboten gestaltet das Unternehmen die digitale Transformation einer ganzen Branche aktiv mit. Im Mittelpunkt stehen massgeschneiderte Entwicklungen, zuverlässiger Support und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung komplexer Fachapplikationen. Das Tätigkeitsfeld reicht von der Softwareentwicklung über Beratung und Einführung bis hin zu Wartung und Schulung. Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit prägen den Alltag. Das Unternehmen setzt auf langfristige Perspektiven und fördert gezielt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung seiner Mitarbeitenden. Bereit, an Lösungen zu arbeiten, die wirklich einen Unterschied machen? Der Rocken Partner freut sich auf Deine Bewerbung!

Rolle

Du entwickelst gerne Software, die im Alltag einen konkreten Nutzen schafft und gleichzeitig technisch anspruchsvoll bleibt? In dieser Funktion arbeitest du an komplexen Web-Applikationen, bringst deine Erfahrung in verschiedene Projekte ein und begleitest Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Umsetzung.

Verantwortung

Du entwickelst und wartest anspruchsvolle Web-Applikationen mit .NET und C#.
Du arbeitest mit Microsoft SQL Server und setzt technische Anforderungen in robuste Softwarelösungen um.
Du bringst deine Entwicklungskompetenz in unterschiedliche Scrum-Projekte ein und arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen.
Du unterstützt Lösungsarchitekten und Projektleiter bei der technischen Umsetzung – vom Lösungskonzept bis zur Abnahme.
Du unterstützt die Produktberatung bei der Analyse und Lösung technischer Fragestellungen aus Kundenprojekten.
Du führst Code-Reviews und Unit-Tests durch und trägst damit aktiv zur Qualität und Wartbarkeit der Software bei.

Qualifikationen

Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.
Du bringst praktische und fundierte Erfahrung mit .NET/C# und Microsoft SQL Server mit.
Du hast ein Studium in Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik oder Technik abgeschlossen.
Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.
Du hast Freude an agilen Methoden, Scrum und kollaborativer Teamarbeit.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

Beteiligung an gesundheitlichen Massnahmen
Beteiligung oder Übernahme beim Handy und Notebook
Homeoffice
Beteiligung oder Übernahme ÖV-Abonnements
Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Attraktive Leistungen bei Krankheit oder Unfall
Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
Markt- und leistungsgerechte Löhne

jobs.title: Computer Programmer
jobs.description:
Company Description
EgoTECHworld is a trusted technology partner that offers cutting-edge IT solutions to a diverse range of clients. The company provides opportunities for individuals to gain valuable industry experience through real-world projects and exposure to modern technologies. EgoTECHworld also shares insightful tech articles, helping professionals stay informed about trends and best practices in the field. Team members benefit from a culture that values learning, innovation, and practical problem-solving.
Role Description
The Computer Programmer role at EgoTECHworld is a full-time remote position focused on designing, coding, testing, and maintaining software applications and back-end systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing efficient, reusable code, debugging and resolving technical issues, and collaborating with other developers, designers, and stakeholders to implement technical requirements. The programmer will participate in code reviews, follow established development practices, and contribute to improving system performance and reliability. The role also involves documenting code, integrating APIs and databases, and staying current with emerging tools, frameworks, and best practices relevant to the company’s technology stack.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
Proficiency in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with experience in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Python, or similar).
Hands-on experience in Software Development, including designing, implementing, and maintaining applications or services.
Knowledge of Back-End Web Development, such as working with server-side frameworks, APIs, and databases.
Ability to write clean, well-documented code and use version control systems (e.g., Git).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to code quality.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, and ability to collaborate in a remote, distributed team environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with software testing, debugging tools, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices is beneficial.
